title: D-CALM: A Dynamic Clustering-based Active Learning Approach for Mitigating Bias
findings: The proposed active learning method, D-CALM, creates a more equitable distribution of annotated samples for hatespeech detection compared to baseline methods. For instance, the TopN baseline method heavily oversampled hatespeech targeting Jews while undersampling other groups. D-CALM balanced this sampling, leading to improved performance and reduced bias. The error analysis also noted model confusion between hatespeech targeting Jews and Muslims, as both target religions.
